gates.title: Pre-registration fixed first
gates.detail: The plan embedded in the results hashes to bc930ea63fac5e7a721365d85ce29528bb7f96a89c03fff3f6693c6383d6121d. The pre-registration file was committed unmodified in 150da3b on 2026-11-04T12:42:21-06:00, before the run started (2026-11-04T18:42:24.910Z).

gates.title: Design followed
gates.detail: 84 sessions in 1 condition: blocks of two, the arm that goes first alternating, 2 warm-up blocks first, 40 measured per arm, exactly the plan's schedule, rules and stream.

gates.title: Configuration proved
gates.detail: 82 finished sessions: the page reported the configuration of its arm, with exactly its overrides, and played through Media Source Extensions.

gates.title: Condition applied, the same in both arms
gates.detail: 82 finished sessions: the service held exactly the registered rules, and every rule fired on at least 36 requests of the session (57 to 69 requests per session); both arms were created with the same rules.

gates.title: Failures few and even
gates.detail: 2 of 80 measured sessions failed (reported, never dropped): under the pre-registered maximum of 10 % of an arm, and the arms failed alike.

gates.title: Machine quiet at the start
gates.detail: The 1-minute load average was 3.7 before the first session, on 12 CPUs (the limit is 50 % of them, 6.0).

gates.title: A/A check passed (PB-AB-001)
gates.detail: docs/results/ab/PB-AB-001-bandwidth-drop-finite-40s.local-darwin-arm64.20261104T175652Z.report.json: the real interleaved A/A and its calibration passed for bandwidth-drop-finite on chromium in local-darwin-arm64.

validity.summary: VALID: the experiment was run as pre-registered, on data that pass all 7 gates. The direction of the result does not enter: it drives the decision named for the row.

startRungs.note: The arms never started on the same rung (A: 720p: 39; B: 240p: 39). Any difference in startup, and in the first seconds of playback, includes whatever the first rung does: the first rung is set by the configuration (ADR-064), and the two configurations are compared as shipped, so this experiment cannot say how much of a difference is the first rung and how much is the rest of the configuration. A rung-matched comparison is not possible with these data.

decision.headline: Equivalent within the margin: no meaningful difference (keep A)
decision.reason: Every primary interval lies inside its margin (Share of sessions with a rebuffer -9 pp to +9 pp within ±20 pp), so the data show that nothing worth a change is there.

readings.label: Share of sessions with a rebuffer
readings.sentence: Share of sessions with a rebuffer: B minus A is 0 pp (95 % interval -9 pp to +9 pp), threshold 20 pp, adjusted p = 1.0: equivalent: the whole interval is inside the margin

steps: 1. Harm (worse than the threshold with an interval that excludes zero): none.
2. Benefit (adjusted p < 0.05 and the whole interval beyond the threshold in B's favour): none; worse end of the interval not inside the threshold: none.
3. Equivalence (the whole interval inside the margin of plus or minus the threshold): 1 of 1 (rebufferShare).
4. Failed sessions: 2 of 80 failed, guard not tripped.

exploratory.title: Metrics that were not pre-registered
exploratory.note: Recorded in every session and compared here with the same tests, but with raw p-values, no adjustment and no threshold: they describe, they decide nothing, and one in twenty of them will look significant by chance.

exploratory.title: Startup within the rung the sessions started on (rung-matched)
exploratory.note: No start rung was reached by at least 5 sessions of both arms: a rung-matched comparison is not possible with these data.
